problem_restatement.question: Does the current V58 evidence set prove an exact, recoverable V57-to-V58 live transition can be executed after a future human approval?
success_criteria: exact candidate config and provider contracts are validated
fresh flat and order-free preflight reconciles all eight assets
candidate stress evidence is bound to the exact config and preflight
V57-to-V58 transition and rollback sequence is machine-readable and tested
a V58 accounting epoch bundle exists and matches the exact approved profile
post-start acceptance binds the new run to exact V58 identity and evidence
the TUI renders all eight assets, route directions, sizing, exits, blockers, and CLI-only safety

latest_preflight.interpretation: This is point-in-time technical evidence and must be regenerated at any future cutover boundary.

sequencing_decision.action_now: Continue the frozen V57/V58/MU prospective evidence windows and do not create an accounting epoch or launch runbook for a route set that is not yet approved.
sequencing_decision.action_after_supportive_evidence_and_hum: Freeze the exact route set, generate and verify a V58 accounting epoch, write and test the exact V57-to-V58 transition/rollback contract, regenerate a fresh flat/order-free preflight, then launch only with the explicit live-risk flags and execute post-start acceptance.
sequencing_decision.why: Accounting and transition artifacts bind operational authority to an exact profile. Creating them before route disposition and human approval risks certifying stale or later-edited strategy authority.

single_highest_value_next_investigation.primary: Resolve the first exact HYPE alignment-v2 lifecycle while the frozen V57 watcher remains active.
parallel: Resolve the open SP500 fresh15-v3 prospective short only at a configured exit.
Continue the independent MU source-native window until its preregistered minimum 20 onsets and five per side or the fixed deadline.
single_highest_value_next_investigation.not_selected: Building launch artifacts before route evidence and explicit approval.

change_review.1_recommendation: Keep V57 live unchanged and classify V58 as operationally partial, report-only, and not launch-ready.
change_review.2_why_now: The latest V58 preflight can be mistaken for cutover readiness even though the exact transition/rollback contract and accounting epoch are absent.
change_review.3_evidence_reviewed: Exact V58 config, latest immutable preflight, growth-sizing stress artifact, post-start acceptance implementation/tests, staged TUI acceptance, accounting-epoch directory, and runbook/guide inventory.
change_review.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: Most technical components exist, but two authority-critical artifacts are missing and current route economics remain prospective or contradictory.
change_review.5_applicable_market_regime: Operational identity and recovery are regime-independent; economic route conclusions remain limited to their frozen evidence windows.
6_alternatives_considered: treat the point-in-time preflight as launch approval
generate an accounting epoch and runbook now
cut over without a recoverable transition contract
defer authority artifacts until evidence and human approval freeze the route set
change_review.8_expected_upside: Prevents stale identity, accounting contamination, and irrecoverable cutover errors while preserving the active prospective evidence pipeline.
9_main_risks_and_failure_modes: A later V58 route/config edit invalidates current preflight and stress identities.
A point-in-time flat account can become non-flat before cutover.
Missing accounting epoch can mix V57 and V58 performance attribution.
Missing rollback sequencing can leave an open lifecycle or owned order unmanaged during transition.
Deferring launch artifacts adds preparation time after a future approval.
change_review.10_validation_completed: Exact config/preflight/stress/post-start/TUI artifact inventory and filesystem proof that no V58 transition runbook or accounting epoch currently exists.
change_review.11_validation_still_required: Supportive route evidence or an explicit operator decision to run an ungated trial; exact approved route freeze; V58 accounting epoch; tested transition/rollback runbook; fresh cutover preflight; verified prestart backup; live post-start acceptance.
change_review.12_success_metrics: All success criteria in problem_restatement are present, hash-bound to one approved profile, and pass at a flat/order-free boundary without changing unrelated runtime state.
change_review.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any profile/hash drift, open position, owned order, stale preflight, missing backup, epoch mismatch, TUI identity mismatch, runtime fault, or post-start rejection aborts the cutover and preserves V57 or returns flat before rollback.

limitations: Filesystem absence proves the named V58 artifacts are missing now; it does not predict whether they can be generated successfully later.
The current preflight is a transient read-only snapshot and does not authorize a later cutover.
The stress artifact measures deterministic modeled loss scenarios, not future expectancy or a loss ceiling.
No live strategy, asset, route, parameter, sizing, leverage, risk control, deployment configuration, order, or process was changed.
falsifiers: An exact V57-to-V58 transition/rollback runbook and matching V58 accounting epoch are found and independently verify against the current profile.
The current V58 config, preflight, stress, post-start, or TUI evidence hashes differ from those recorded here.
A later approved V58 profile intentionally changes route, side, sizing, leverage, exit, or asset identity, requiring a new readiness record.
A fresh flat-boundary acceptance proves every success criterion under one exact approved identity.
